text: I'm looking after my grandson tonight, he's 10 months. He's had a few runny nappies this evening, I think three maybe four. Otherwise he seems himself. He's taken his bottles as normal and he's drinking well, and he's still weeing fine as far as I can tell, the wet nappies are the same as usual. Not sure if there's anything I should be doing for the runny poo or if I just keep going as we are. His mum is back tomorrow.
